---
title: "User Guide"
guide-section: "Quick Start"
---

**Where to start:**

* *New to the codebase?* Read [Architecture](00-architecture.qmd) for the map,
  then the [Glossary](01-concepts.qmd) for the vocabulary (pools, aliases,
  rounds, purchases), and continue into the Reference from there.
* *Evaluating strategies?* Read the "leak rules" section of the architecture
  page first, because everything else is designed around them. Then read
  [Evaluation](02-evaluation.qmd): how a model is played, what a run writes, and
  how two conditions are compared.
